notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B sales enablement) evaluating Redwood for outbound SDR/chat agents that must perform tool-calls into their CRM, send emails, and surface calendar invites from chat. Primary constraint is perceived latency — reps must feel responses are instantaneous during live demo calls. Interested in starting on Hosted API to iterate quickly, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data separation.

Recent quote: "If streaming feels slow our SDRs lose trust — target 1st-token under 150ms, per-token under 80ms ideally." — Head of Product.

Technical notes: POC currently uses streaming + tool-calling prototype hitting HubSpot API and internal calendar service. Observed tail latency spikes when batch sizes >8 for multi-step tool calls. KV cache hit rate 72% on warm sessions. Asking for suggestions on batching/caching profiles and quantization recommendations for cost reduction.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, want KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk). Data residency: prefer NA but flexible as long as audit trail preserved. Legal reviewing retention controls and delete APIs.

Business: Mid-market, ~450 employees, currently paying for two AI vendors for embedding/search and chat prototypes. Will consolidate if price + latency meet bar. ARR signal: looking at 75-200k ARR depending on committed throughput and support SLA.

Sales process notes: demo (2026-02-25) went well w/ live agent simulation; follow-up POC requested (2 weeks) instrumented for p99 latency, TTFB, and token cost. Pricing ask: committed burst-capacity option; SLA on latency for Dedicated. AE/SE alignment: Maya/Diego doing architecture call 2026-03-16. CSM (Priya) looped in once contract terms near final.

Links: demo recording ff-2026-03-02-prospectpilot-demo, pricing deck (drive link), security Q&A (drive).

Shorthand next: POC metrics spec, Dedicated pricing by 3/20, legal deliverables (data retention + KMS docs).
